current.text: He had wrist surgery after the playoffs. He is expected to be ready for opening night.
He played about two extra months last season on the Knicks' run to the championship.
Several experts worry about a Finals hangover. He may start slow, lose some production to fatigue and get extra rest.
The Knicks are expected to be careful with their main players over the first 30 or so games. Starters' minutes will be trimmed and there will be more rest on back-to-backs.
He is the projected starting point guard next to Bridges, Hart, Anunoby and Towns.
He is projected at about 31 percent usage and 35 minutes.

In category leagues, experts see him as a fourth-round player, worth about pick 39 to 48. They say not to take him in the third round. They also say to avoid him at his Yahoo rank of 29 or an ADP of 21 to 23.
In category leagues, one expert sees a best case of 22nd and a worst case of 91st.
In an auction mock draft, the expert valued him at about 18 USD. He sold for 20 USD.
The Knicks are projected to win about 50 to 54 games.

durable.text: He is worth much more in points leagues than in category leagues. Points-based rankings overrate him for us.
He is a high-usage scorer whose points are a league outlier. He adds good free throws, solid threes and good assists for a guard.
He barely rebounds and adds very few steals. His blocks are among the weakest for a guard.
Experts disagree on his FG%. Some call it below average and others call it good. His projection is about league average and slightly above average for a guard.

note: Category experts see Brunson as a fourth-round player, not the top-30 player the markets price. Yahoo's average cost is 33.3 USD and ESPN's is 42.3 USD. Our league paid 31 USD last season, but an expert auction mock valued him at about 18 USD and he sold for 20 USD. In our 9-cat league, let others pay 30 USD or more. He makes sense at about 20 to 25 USD in a punt BLK build that wants points, FT%, threes and assists from a guard. Early in the season, check his minutes, rest on back-to-backs and his wrist. The Knicks plan to be careful with starters for the first 30 or so games after the Finals run.
